BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has announced further transactions in its own shares as part of its share buyback programme. Between April 7th and April 10th, 2026, the company purchased a total of 993,712 ordinary shares at an average price of 295.35 pence per share, with the lowest price paid being 288.80 pence and the highest at 298.60 pence. Following these purchases, Serco's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 997,115,251, with 5,630,763 shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights is now 997,115,251. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 10 April 2026 10 April 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 07 April 2026 260,000 290.3506 288.8000 292.2000 08 April 2026 259,429 295.9324 292.0000 298.6000 09 April 2026 233,863 296.9220 294.6000 298.4000 10 April 2026 250,000 297.3876 294.8000 299.2000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 997,115,251 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 5,630,763 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 10 April 2026 is 997,115,251 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 5 March 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 5,630,763 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
